# directus_policy (Resource)

Manages a Directus access policy (directus_policies).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the policy.

### Optional

- `admin_access` (Boolean) Whether the policy grants full administrative access.
- `app_access` (Boolean) Whether the policy grants access to the Directus app.
- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `enforce_tfa` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enforced for this policy.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the policy.
- `ip_access` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed IP addresses/CIDRs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned policy UUID.
